title: Changelog playbook and customer-facing summary for March launch
creator: Sara Patel
description: Create a repeatable playbook and final copy for both internal release notes and the customer-facing changelog for the March console release. Deliverables: 1) internal release brief for engineering/support/sales, 2) curated customer changelog (short + long variants), 3) one-page HTML snippet for the product announcement and docs, 4) checklist for approvals and localized translations.
